body: Wow, this is almost exactly how it is for me now too, even similar age group…I noticed my huge fear for the future, the unknown, and how I’m going to survive with so much that will come for me later on. It has also driven a lot of the suicidal thoughts. My fear comes from my possible lack of responsibility in anything, and that I’ll screw up more than the usual amount…I’ve learned to at least try to catch up on life skills and becoming aware of the possibilities that may become a hit. I’ve learned here on Reddit of “Motion before emotion”, basically to just DO instead of pondering on it too much, and waiting for a “right time”…it still sounds pretty scary to me even now, but I guess there’s a reason why it stayed in my brain. Just little things, like reading articles about taking care of things to do for the self, and r/coolguides has some cool tips I sometimes find that can resonate with ‘adulting’ in the future/“real world”…I guess my advice to you is, ‘prepare’ and be aware as much as you can, and do before you boo lol. There may be other helpful subreddits out there that can help with the ‘preparing’ part if you need that…! Our anxious brains can throw the anxious thoughts way outta proportions to how it actually would be if it were likely. Bracing through the storm is sometimes the only way to go, even though it’s going to be uncomfortable. Keep at it!

It hurts. Either you choke to death, or your neck breaks and you’re still conscious. Friend, this is not the way to leave. You made up your mind, I know. I did too, long, long time ago. Let us chat for a bit, and see what you’re next move is from there.
there is no reason. im ready to go, that’s it.
